characteristics: Anti-armor warhead (shaped charge), longer range/endurance than Switchblade 300, man-in-the-loop targeting
Strength: Purpose-built anti-armor capability at the loitering-munition scale, filling a niche between man-portable ATGMs and larger strike UAVs
Limitation: Larger and heavier than the 300 variant, reducing man-portability
Estimated quantity available: Delivered numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Donated specifically to give infantry-scale anti-armor precision strike, functionally similar in role to Russia's Lancet
contrast_vs_traditional: The 600's anti-armor warhead extends the same squad-level distributed-kill-chain logic as the 300 to a target class — tanks and hardened vehicles — that traditional doctrine held was an anti-tank-guided-missile or close-air-support job. A loitering munition doing that from an infantry-level launch point compresses that chain to the same single-digit-minute timeline doctrine.md describes for the rest of the drone-mediated kill chain.
